summary: Added 39 unique, DOI/Crossref-verified primary empirical studies to docs/research/supervisors/psychology-primary.json (88 -> 127 total), closing out the learning-psychology corpus's own evidence floor. Seven parallel research passes were each given the full 88-DOI batch-1/2/3 exclusion list up front; several passes explicitly dropped otherwise-real, non-excluded candidates (e.g. Kalyuga et al. 1998, Benware & Deci 1984, Beilock & Carr 2005, Bandura & Cervone 1983) when an exact sample size could not be independently confirmed, rather than estimating it. Every one of the 39 candidate DOIs was independently re-verified by this session directly against the live Crossref API during compilation (not just trusting each pass's self-report), and duplicate-DOI/title checks against the existing 88-record corpus and the 39 new candidates were run programmatically. This re-verification caught four defects the research passes did not report themselves, all fixed before finalizing: one DOI (10.5465/256353) 301-redirected to its true canonical DOI (10.2307/256353), which was substituted as persistentId/sourceUrl; one record was drafted with an ERIC id that, on independent verification, resolved to an unrelated 1988 article and was replaced with a verified OpenAlex source; one record's two verification sources were both non-identity-authority hosts (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, api.openalex.org) and the Crossref API URL was substituted as the first source; and two research-pass-reported second sources (an OUP publisher page, an INFORMS publisher page) plus one CiteSeerX link returned 403/connection-failure on independent re-fetch and were replaced with confirmed PubMed or OpenAlex alternatives. Two files.eric.ed.gov PDF second-sources were opened and their extracted text (not just HTTP status) confirmed to name the correct authors/title/DOI. The batch deliberately distributed the 39 new records across all 12 topics still below the 8-study floor (2-3 each) plus the two already-strong topics (2 each), bringing every one of the corpus's 14 topics to 8 or 9 records (127 total, max 7.9% per topic) -- comfortably clearing the 'at least 5 topics with >=8 studies' and '<=35% per topic' thresholds from docs/research/supervisor-evidence-contract.md #1a with an even distribution rather than a bare-minimum pass. The learning-psychology domain now passes the full (non---partial) check-supervisor-evidence.mjs gate on its own (127/100, 14 topics); the overall two-domain gate still reports pedagogical short of 100, which is a separate lane's write scope and out of this task's responsibility per LC-SUP-001.

evidence.frontend: cd linguachat-frontend && npm run check:all && npm run build && npm run check:i18n — exit 0, run twice consecutively clean after merging origin/main
evidence.backend: cd linguachat-backend && python -m compileall . && python -m pytest -q — exit 0 (444 passed), run twice consecutively clean after merging origin/main
evidence.evidenceGatePartial: node .github/scripts/check-supervisor-evidence.mjs --partial psychology — psychology: 127 unique primary studies; 14 topics; partial gate passed
evidence.evidenceGateFull: node .github/scripts/check-supervisor-evidence.mjs — psychology: 127/100 unique primary studies, 14 topics, all thresholds cleared (READY); pedagogical: 93/100, a separate lane's write scope, not this task's responsibility
evidence.scopeGuard: node .github/scripts/check-foundry-scope.mjs --branch foundry/research-psy/lc-res-y04 --base origin/main --head HEAD — OK, 2 changed files (corpus json, batch doc), all inside allowed write scope
